The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. The trajectory decoder shows a monotonic dose response in the bias…

results.title: Your Vision-Language-Action Model Already Has Attention Heads For Path Deviation Detection
results.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong potential for predicting semantic actions in navigation tasks, demonstrating the ability to reason over complex linguistic instructions and visual contexts. However, they are fundamentally hindered by visual-reasoning hallucinations that lead to trajectory deviations. Addressing this issue has conventionally required training external critic modules or relying on complex uncertainty heuristics. In this work, we discover that monitoring a few attention heads within a frozen VLA model can accurately detect path deviations without incu…

findings.point: VLA 驾驶模型可在推理阶段通过注意力偏向机制重定向视觉注意力，无需重新训练即可聚焦安全关键交通参与者
findings.evidence: 在 Alpamayo-R1 的 Qwen3-VL 主干上应用有界加性 pre-softmax 注意力偏置，作用于检测器定位的交通参与者视觉 token，实现推理时注意力引导
findings.authority: arXiv 预印本 (cs.CV), 未经同行评审
findings.attention: 中：新方法针对 VLA 驾驶安全痛点，但为单篇预印本，暂无独立复现或基准榜单验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：解决 VLA 推理时可控性的新思路，工程落地潜力大，需等待真机/仿真基准验证

findings.point: 现有 VLA 模型内部已存在可用于路径偏离检测的注意力头，无需外部模块或额外训练即可挖掘
findings.evidence: 发现 VLA 模型固有的注意力头能检测视觉推理幻觉导致的轨迹偏离，传统做法需训练外部分类器，本工作证明内部表征已蕴含该能力
findings.authority: arXiv 预印本 (cs.RO), 未经同行评审
findings.attention: 中：揭示 VLA 内在机制的重要发现，但为单篇预印本，尚无第三方复现或在多本体/多任务上验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆：为 VLA 可解释性与安全监控提供低成本方案，极具后续研究价值，建议重点跟踪

findings.point: 近 1-2 年 VLA 领域出现推理时干预（attention steering）与内在机制挖掘（attention head probing）两类免训练增强范式
findings.evidence: 综合 [4] 与 [5]：前者在推理期施加注意力偏置引导行为，后者挖掘模型自带注意力头做偏离检测，均避免重新训练，代表当前 VLA 安全/可控研究的新方向
findings.authority: 两篇 arXiv 预印本，均未同行评审
findings.attention: 中：两篇 2026 年工作指向相似免训练范式，形成早期趋势信号，但缺乏基准榜单或大规模实验佐证
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：趋势判断基于仅两篇预印本，需更多工作与独立验证才能确立

results.snippet: Omnidirectional vision, using 360-degree vision to understand the environment, has become increasingly critical across domains like robotics, industrial inspection, and environmental monitoring. Compared to traditional pinhole vision, omnidirectional vision provides holistic environmental awareness, significantly enhancing the completeness of scene perception and the reliability of decision-making. However, foundational research in this area has historically lagged behind traditional pinhole vision. This talk presents an emerging trend in the embodied AI era: the rapid development of omnidire…

results.title: Multi-Step Guided Diffusion for Image Restoration on Edge Devices: Toward Lightweight Perception in Embodied AI
results.snippet: Diffusion models have shown remarkable flexibility for solving inverse problems without task-specific retraining. However, existing approaches such as Manifold Preserving Guided Diffusion (MPGD) apply only a single gradient update per denoising step, limiting restoration fidelity and robustness, especially in embedded or out-of-distribution settings. In this work, we introduce a multistep optimization strategy within each denoising timestep, significantly enhancing image quality, perceptual accuracy, and generalization. Our experiments on super-resolution and Gaussian deblurring demonstrate t…

results.title: Aligning Cyber Space with Physical World: A Comprehensive Survey on Embodied AI
results.snippet: Embodied Artificial Intelligence (Embodied AI) is crucial for achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) and serves as a foundation for various applications (e.g., intelligent mechatronics systems, smart manufacturing) that bridge cyberspace and the physical world. Recently, the emergence of Multi-modal Large Models (MLMs) and World Models (WMs) have attracted significant attention due to their remarkable perception, interaction, and reasoning capabilities, making them a promising architecture for embodied agents. In this survey, we give a comprehensive exploration of the latest advancem…

findings.point: 基础模型透明度显著下降，训练数据与算力信息不透明成为行业共性问题，可能影响 VLA 模型的可复现性与合规部署
findings.evidence: 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index 显示平均透明度分数从 2024 年的 58 分跌至 2025 年的 40 分；企业在训练数据、训练算力及部署后使用影响方面最为不透明
findings.authority: arXiv preprint (cs.AI), 作者含 Percy Liang、Rishi Bommasani 等知名学者

findings.point: 全向视觉（360° 感知）被确立为具身 AI 时代的关键感知范式，传统针孔相机视野受限导致场景感知不完整
findings.evidence: PANORAMA 综述指出全向视觉提供整体环境感知，显著提升场景感知完整性与决策可靠性；工业需求与学术兴趣双驱动，该领域基础研究正快速追赶传统视觉
findings.authority: arXiv preprint (cs.CV), 15 位作者含 Luc Van Gool 等计算机视觉权威
findings.attention: 高，标题明确 "Embodied AI Era"，多机构联合撰写，近期提交（2025-09）
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆，系统梳理全向视觉在具身智能中的崛起，为 VLA 多模态感知扩展提供直接技术参考

findings.point: 边缘设备上的轻量化感知（扩散模型多步引导复原）是具身 AI 落地的关键瓶颈，单步梯度更新限制复原保真度与鲁棒性
findings.evidence: 针对边缘/分布外场景，现有 MPGD 等单步引导扩散方法保真度不足；提出多步优化引导扩散以提升嵌入式设备上的图像复原质量
findings.authority: arXiv preprint (cs.CV), 聚焦边缘部署工程落地
findings.attention: 中，解决 VLA 真机部署的感知算力瓶颈，但为单篇方法论文，尚无大规模基准验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆，切中 VLA 边缘推理痛点，但需关注后续在真机基准（如 Open X-Embodiment）上的验证

findings.point: 具身 AI 领域已形成多模态大模型（MLM）与世界模型（WM）双主线演进，但网络空间与物理世界对齐的系统性挑战仍未解决
findings.evidence: 2024 年综述（v8 更新至 2025）指出 MLMs 与 WMs 受关注度显著上升，但 "Aligning Cyber Space with Physical World" 仍为核心难题，涉及智能机电系统、智能制造等应用

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 一句话增量判断
近 1-2 年 VLA 领域出现**免训练推理时干预**与**模型内在机制挖掘**两大新范式，均聚焦于安全性与可控性，但均处于预印本阶段，缺乏独立基准验证与真机部署证据。

### 1.2 关键进展条目

|---|------|------|-----------|----------|----------|--------|--------|------|
